_comment: Maps free-text state values that 44.tbladdress_Assign_StateID.sql could not match onto the canonical tblState.StateShort code. Keys must exist in tblState.StateShort. Matching ignores case, whitespace and punctuation, so 'N.S.W.', 'N S W' and 'nsw' already resolve without an entry - only genuinely different words need listing here.
